subject: Improve surgical annotation accuracy
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed [COMPANY] is expanding surgical data annotation efforts - critical function to connect surgical insights with robotic operations. We've been working with Moon Surgical, Kaliber Labs, and Telos Health at similar intersections, helping them improve annotation consistency across surgical video, robotic ops and medical imaging (DICOM/NIfTI).

With Encord, surgical teams consolidate these tasks in one platform. Our capabilities like temporal interpolation & tracking, nested attributes, and workflow orchestration have helped them reduce manual labelling time, capture granular surgical context, and flag deviations more reliably.

Would you be open to a quick chat to see if those challenges resonate with what you're seeing at [COMPANY]? We're flexible morning times CT.

subject: Improving annotation accuracy for DICOM
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed you were building out machine-assisted labelling capabilities for you medical computer vision models. We've been working with Moon Surgical, Asensus Surgical and Kaliber Labs on similar projects, helping them improve annotation consistency across surgical video, medical imaging (DICOM/NIfTI) and robotic ops.

With Encord, surgical teams orchestrate model-assisted labelling and surgical practitioner feedbacks in one platform. You can bring custom models for auto-labelling + leverage our SAM2 integration alongside quality assessment tool to gain visibility into the entire annotation and review process, with the goals of surfacing granular anatomical contexts more reliably.

Would you be open to a quick chat to see if those challenges resonate with what you're seeing at PROCEPT? We're flexible morning times PT.
